note: BH-8945: on a pool machine (LEAD_REVIEW_EPHEMERAL=1) a lead review report past the 4000-unit artifact cap is pushed whole to the job transcript as lead_report and read back. At most this many pushes, then one alert (lead-report-push-<job>); the review stays done with the prefix artifact. The code fallback in bin/lib/lead-review/result.sh lr_push_report_checked is this default.
